items: The hard part of AI for multi-location brands is rolling a successful single-store pilot out across every location.
Judge AI like any other tool: if it does not save money, make money or add speed at scale, it does not belong in your tech stack.
The AI that scales is the most repeatable: it integrates with your existing systems, needs little setup and proves its return quickly.
Give AI the context of your own metrics, such as what net revenue means at your company, so your teams can trust its answers.
